result.rationale: The migration creates embed_url as t.string (default VARCHAR(255)) with a unique index. URLs, especially with query strings, can exceed 255 chars; TopicEmbed.create! would raise (destroying the surrounding transaction in TopicEmbed.import), so the embed never persists and topic_id_for_embed never resolves. The mechanism is visible in the diff, though the practical likelihood is moderate.
